text:
ITEM 1 | Large pieces of pale golden-tan coated protein, breaded or crusted with a fine, speckled, slightly crumbly coating showing darker brown flecks and some browning at edges; roughly 4 chunky pieces, each about 5-6 cm long and 2-3 cm thick, with a dry matte surface and visible shredded/fibrous interior at cut edges; sits on the right side of the plate, partly covered by green herb strands | 230

ITEM 2 | Fine bright green thread-like herb strands, slightly wilted and limp, lying draped across the top of item 1 and scattered over the plate; each strand about 5-10 cm long and very thin, with a slightly moist sheen | 12

ITEM 3 | Small cluster of sliced meat pieces in the lower-left center of the plate, rosy-pink to brown with darker seared edges and a slightly glossy, juicy look at cut faces; roughly 4-5 pieces each about 2-3 cm across and 1 cm thick, with a fibrous grain visible | 75

ITEM 4 | Small dark green leafy garnish, a single crumpled piece about 3 cm across, dull matte green with slightly darker veining, lying beside item 3 | 4

ITEM 5 | Thin scattered orange-tan fragments and small crumbs of coating, about 1 cm pieces, dry and matte, dispersed near item 3 and along the plate rim | 3

ITEM 6 | Thin light-brown crumbs and small specks of breading scattered around the plate edges, dry and crumbly | 2
